test_title: General intelligence and Reasoning Ability Mock Test 40

questions.question: Seven boxes E, F, G, H, I, J and W are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only two boxes are kept below G. Only one box is kept above J. Only one box is kept between J and W. I is kept immediately above F. E is kept at some place below H. How many boxes are kept between H and F?

In this question two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements maybe the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct option.Statements:I. Amit got diagnosed with Type-II diabetes few days ago during a regular check-up.II. Amit has decided to stop consuming sugar and foods, which have high carbohydrates.
options: Both statements I and II are effects of independent causes.
Statement II is the cause, and statement I is its possible effect.
Statement I is the cause, and statement II is its possible effect.
Both statements I and II are effects of some common cause.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Statement I is the cause, and statement II is its possible effect.) है।

questions.question: 235 is related to 131 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 268 is related to 164. To which of the following is 315 related, following the same logic?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:Some books are papers.No paper is a slate.All slates are copies.Conclusions:(I) Some slates are papers.(II) Some papers are copies.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

खुशबू, सुरेश, रीना, नेहा, परी, यश, सपना और महक एक वर्गाकार मेज के चारों ओर उसके केंद्र की ओर अभिमुख होकर बैठे हैं। उनमें से कुछ मेज के कोनों पर बैठे हैं जबकि कुछ मेज की भुजाओं के ठीक बीच में बैठे हैं।

परी के दाईं ओर से दूसरे और खुशबू के बाईं ओर से तीसरे स्थान पर यश बैठा है।
सपना, महक के दाईं ओर से तीसरे स्थान पर बैठी है, जबकि महक, परी के ठीक पड़ोस में नहीं बैठी है।
नेहा, यश के ठीक दाईं ओर बैठी है जो किसी एक कोने पर बैठा है।
नेहा के दाईं ओर से तीसरे स्थान पर रीना बैठी है।

निम्नलिखित चार में से तीन एक निश्चित तरीके से एकसमान हैं और इस प्रकार एक ग्रुप बनाते हैं। वह कौन है जो उस ग्रुप से संबंधित नहीं है?
